description: Gwyiran Trevadawn wears a deep green knee-length tunic with rich gold knotwork woven borders at the split neckline, front, cuffs and hem over an ivory linen underlayer visible at collar, cuffs and lower hem. A richly worked green checked fringed cloak with matching knotwork borders is fastened by a round shoulder brooch. A broad decorated brown leather belt has round fittings, a round knotwork buckle and long hanging ornamented strap. Brown trousers and tall brown boots with crossed leather ties complete the outfit. His voluminous golden curls are uncovered.
